comment: Frame budgets enforced by tools/bench-editor.py --check. Milliseconds of CPU per frame (build, layout, prepaint, paint), release build, Apple Silicon. Means, not p95: the tail follows machine load. A 120Hz display leaves 8.3ms a frame for everything, the GPU included. Sections are ~24 source lines each (160 = 3845 lines).

scaling.comment: A frame costs what is on screen: a document 16x longer may not cost twice as much.
